title: Faculty of Education and Humanities
text:
The Faculty of Education and Humanities is part of International Burch University. Its introduction emphasises support for current and future teachers and the advancement of education, with a focus on teaching and learning. The faculty describes an interdisciplinary approach that connects practical skills, research and critical thinking. Its educational aims include developing personal integrity and confidence, while preparing students for professional challenges and changes in the labour market.

The faculty page presents four areas of study: English Language and Literature, Graphic Design and Multimedia, Digital Communications and Public Relations, and Film and Video Production. The introduction to the Department of English Language and Literature identifies several possible career directions. These include teaching English, translation, editing, writing digital content and managing web content. International business, government and non-governmental organisations are mentioned as possible working environments.

The Department of Graphic Design and Multimedia emphasises a range of creative careers. Its introduction highlights opportunities to work on different projects and develop different styles. Digital Communications and Public Relations focuses on creating content for social media. This content is directed towards different audiences and specific communication goals. Together, these areas illustrate different ways of connecting creative work with professional communication.

Film and Video Production is presented through the use of modern technology and learning from film industry professionals. The programme emphasises experience of actual filmmaking and preparation for work in the field. Across the faculty, particular emphasis is placed on practical skills, research, and infrastructure and resources connected with industry.

The faculty page also presents four student clubs. Pixel Crew Club offers additional opportunities to develop design skills and build a portfolio beyond regular academic responsibilities. Linguistic Club connects students interested in language and literature and aims to make language approachable beyond the school setting. T-Club brings together students interested in theatre, acting and performance. SAFE describes its goal as promoting student activism in both academic and non-academic environments.

The university's tuition page presents undergraduate and master's tuition for this faculty separately. Its tuition listings distinguish between domestic and international students. Film and Video Production has its own undergraduate entries. On the same page, the university describes support for high-achieving students through partial or full exemptions from tuition payments.
